lines.scene: You left the ledger in the rain.
I noticed. I always notice.
Bupmin, a future king
who cannot keep a page dry
is still my problem. Lucky me.
Come inside. No, the boots too.
You almost said it.
Say the rest or hold the cup.
Nag, nag, nag. Yes.

lines.text: 싫은 얘기 하게 되는 내 맘을 몰라
lines.scene: Someone has to love you

lines.text: 좋은 얘기만 나누고 싶은 내 맘을 몰라
lines.scene: at the volume of a household.
The war can have your silence.

lines.text: 하나부터 열까지 다 널 위한 소리
lines.scene: There. That was almost a kiss

lines.text: 내 말 듣지 않는 너에게는 뻔한 잔소리
lines.scene: and almost an apology.
I'll take almost, tonight.
Don't drip on the numbers.
Drip on me, if you must.

lines.text: 니가 싫다 해도 안 할수가 없는 이야기
lines.scene: Jahee is not the soft part.
Jahee is the part that makes
the soft part possible.

lines.text: 밥은 제때 먹는지 여잔 멀리 하는지
lines.scene: Dry the page.

lines.text: 온 종일을 네 옆에 있고 싶은데
lines.scene: Then come back and be rained on
by a woman who chose you.
